messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout (sha: b7f3a2) triggered automatic monitoring. Detected 5xx spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2 canary pool, error rate 11% over 3m, increased latency. Paging #eng-oncall.
lee.oncall: I'm on it. Observing same in Grafana — error burst started ~04:23 UTC. Canary instances = 12, 7 showing 503.
jess.runtime: I see stack traces referencing 'quant-kernel-v2' timeouts in the logs. Repro locally with the same model variant under synthetic load.
lee.oncall: Do we want to flip the new kernel off? Also can we isolate to canary only? Need fast mitigation.
omar.infra: Routing already limited to canary by rollout config. If kernel flip is quick, do that first before rollback.
lee.oncall: Flipping feature flag `canary-new-quant-kernel` -> false. /ff-toggle canary-new-quant-kernel off
deploy-bot: ACTION: feature-flag off executed by @lee.oncall at 2026-03-17T04:26:10Z. Propagation to canaries starting.
jess.runtime: Flag off acknowledged on 9/12 canary hosts so far. Logs show decreasing kernel timeouts on hosts that received the change.
amy.support: FYI support queue — 3 customers reported truncated responses in last 10m, two are premium. Escalated to SEs.
lee.oncall: Customer impact: estimated 0.8% of total requests affected (mostly short chat flows). No major data loss, responses retriable. Notifying CS to batch-run replays.
omar.infra: Draining remaining canary tasks and starting rollout revert to previous model variant (rollback to sha: a9c4d1). K8s job created: `rollback-canary-4812345678`
lee.oncall: Can someone start a quick smoke: curl -v https://us-west-2.api.redwood.ai/v1/health/generate -> expecting 200 and small p95.
sam.oncall: I'll take over monitoring and the handoff. @lee.oncall handing off incident. Summary: 5xx spike during canary rollout tied to quant kernel; flag toggled off; rollback initiated; impact ~0.8% requests; support notified.
lee.oncall: Handing to @sam.oncall. My next steps: follow up ticket with runtime team, attach logs. Tagging runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-failure
sam.oncall: Taking. Watching rollback status and error-rate dashboards. I'll ping if rollback doesn't drop 5xx < 0.5% in 10m.
jess.runtime: I'll keep digging into kernel timeout root cause (kernel handshake vs CPU saturation). Sharing a perf dump to the thread in a minute.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: rollback-canary-4812345678 started at 2026-03-17T04:29:50Z by infra. Progress: 0/12 -> 4/12 -> 9/12 updated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT update: Severity set P2 (partial service impact). Timeline: alert 04:23, flag off 04:26, rollback start 04:29. Next update in 10m or on change.
sam.oncall: Noted. Will coordinate with support for outbound messaging if impact persists. Pulling in runtime oncall (cc @jess.runtime).
